statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-2004 (PostgreSQL intarray missing validation of type of input to selectivity estimator executes arbitrary code) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 17.8: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-2004/ lists 17.8 as the fixed release for major version 17, and the 17.8 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.8/, include it. Alpine's postgresql17 17.8-r0 is the upgrade to upstream 17.8 and lists CVE-2026-2004 under its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/ce22298320177ae25085d86fbf3b4fc1150c16a2/main/postgresql17/APKBUILD. The DHI postgresql17 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql17 APKBUILD at the aports revision for each package version (the current revision is linked above) and the upstream source release of the same version, and the postgres server binary in every published build (17.7-r0, 17.8-r0, 17.9-r0, 17.10-r0, 17.11-r0 and 17.12-r0), on both x86_64 and aarch64, reports the matching PostgreSQL 17 release. The intarray module is present: _int.so ships in the postgresql17-contrib package of every published build for Alpine 3.23, on both x86_64 and aarch64. The earlier published build for Alpine 3.23 (17.7-r0) is built from an earlier upstream release and its server binary reports that older version, and Alpine applies no backport of this fix to it, so it is recorded as affected; 17.8-r0 and later carry the fix.

CVE-2026-2004 (PostgreSQL intarray missing validation of type of input to selectivity estimator executes arbitrary code) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 18.2: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-2004/ lists 18.2 as the fixed release for major version 18. The fix is commits https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/66ddac6982c6dc0369dc7b2d251f4d210d704a57 ('Require superuser to install a non-built-in selectivity estimator') and https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/b69af3dda26104b54d4e728c6946edcc79a8ac61 ('Harden _int_matchsel() against being attached to the wrong operator') on the REL_18_STABLE branch. Alpine's postgresql18 APKBUILD lists CVE-2026-2004 under its 18.2-r0 secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/59a1f1d230675807d5a95a0c1e57ba5d640ba039/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD. The DHI postgresql18 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built with that APKBUILD from the upstream PostgreSQL source release of the same version. We checked every postgresql18 build published for Alpine 3.23 as of 2026-11-27 (18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0), on both x86_64 and aarch64. In each, the postgres server reports the PostgreSQL release matching the package version. Both parts of the fix are in 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0 and absent from 18.1-r0: the server message the first commit adds, 'must be superuser to specify a non-built-in restriction estimator function', in /usr/libexec/postgresql18/postgres (postgresql18 package), and the call the second commit adds from the intarray selectivity estimator to the new server function get_function_sibling_type, which /usr/lib/postgresql18/_int.so (postgresql18-contrib package) imports by name. 18.2-r0 is the first published build for Alpine 3.23 carrying the fix; 18.1-r0 is affected.
